facts.value: A series of revivals across American religious and public life, including the Cane Ridge revival in Kentucky organized by Barton Stone.

citations.excerpt: The Second Great Awakening was a diverse bundle of revivals affecting a broad swathe of American religious, political, and public life.
At Cane Ridge , Kentucky, preacher Barton Stone organized a massive week-long revival
